Hey Hacky! Long story, sorry. My friend and I are building a mental health journaling app for college students for the Health track. The idea is you write a quick entry each night and the app picks up patterns in your mood over the week and nudges you toward campus resources when things look rough. We have most of the frontend in React Native done (screens, navigation, a cute onboarding flow), but neither of us has really done backend before. We need someone who can set up a Postgres database and a simple API for entries and accounts, and ideally someone who has played with sentiment analysis or NLP so the mood detection isn't just keyword matching. Bonus if they care about mental health and don't mind staying up late. We're beginners but we really want to ship something that works by Sunday. Who should we talk to?
